offline.scope: A fresh official-client offline result from the same publication workflow run remains mandatory.

lifecycle.scope: Actual official 0.0.20 client and exact 0.3.6 HTTP MCP runtime on macOS arm64 in a bounded existing-Tunnel Cloud window with an independent Store; normal client and runtime shutdown, both test Sessions detached, ownership released, and the original stdio service restored and health checked.

cloud.scope: One existing Cloud Tunnel, two independent exact-runtime MCP endpoints, three new messages and two ACKs. Pi sent a message; ChatGPT read and ACKed it; ChatGPT sent a request; Pi read and ACKed it, then created an explicitly associated reply that ChatGPT found and read through Cloud.
cloud.cleanupMeaning: Bounded normal stop and restoration completed; the existing hardStopCleanup schema field does not claim forced-kill recovery.
cloud.requestCorrelation: Cloud tool calls and local Unix-socket calls were observed in this qualification run and corroborated against the isolated Store receipts, audit events and message association; no payload bodies are retained in repository evidence.

qualification.artifactScope: The Cloud runtime was built from the clean merge commit used for the canonical archive, before adding evidence-only compatibility files that do not affect runtimeDigest.

operations.productionMcpSource: existing development worktree; unchanged by this qualification

limitations: Manual Cloud covers macOS arm64, Node 24.21.0 and node-sqlite with official Client 0.0.20 and one existing Tunnel; other platforms and real namespaced Cloud identity are NOT_VERIFIED.
The Pi test peer was an exact-candidate MCP runtime driven by the operator, not a production Pi Session; native inbound, automatic model wake, task execution and desktop submission are NOT_VERIFIED.
ACK records reception only; forced-kill recovery, unknown-result replay, exactly-once business completion and remote revoke or timeout scenarios are NOT_VERIFIED.

The first parallel Pi fixture start lost the exclusive empty-database creation race, exited before acquiring Owner, and then succeeded when started sequentially; it was not relabeled as a successful first start.
The restored production MCP still runs from the pre-existing development worktree; npm installation does not update that command.
The reviewed operator reset restored the external three-start budget to 0/3 before the window; the HTTP start and stdio restoration consumed two attempts, leaving 2/3 used.
A fresh official-client offline result from the same authorized publication workflow run remains mandatory.
